title: Pig kidney kept a man off dialysis for nine months in world first | New Scientist
description: A pig kidney transplant worked for a record nine months. This enabled the recipient to stay off dialysis for longer while waiting for a suitable human donor's kidney to become available
author: Chris Simms

title: Psilocybin could prevent common and debilitating chemotherapy side effect | New Scientist
description: Many people who have chemotherapy develop numbness, tingling and pain in their hands and feet, which can disrupt their treatment. But research suggests that psilocybin, the psychedelic in magic mushrooms, could prevent this side effect
author: Carissa Wong

title: Rapid climate change brings wildfire threat to new corners of Europe | New Scientist
description: Scorching conditions this year have triggered wildfires in European countries that are normally considered to be damp and cool
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Pygmy raccoons teach each other to make toys out of paper and sand | New Scientist
description: Critically endangered pygmy raccoons on Cozumel Island in Mexico have shown remarkable creativity by making balls out of rubbish at beach clubs
author: Matt von Hippel

title: 'Not-quite primordial' black holes may explain baffling JWST discovery | New Scientist
description: The James Webb Space Telescope seems to have discovered more ancient black holes than theory had predicted, and now we have a new way to explain why
author: Matt von Hippel

title: Saturn has a big, weird decagon around its south pole | New Scientist
description: A decagon – a geometric polygon with 10 sides and 10 angles – has been found on Saturn, and nobody is quite sure how it got there
author: Jonathan O’Callaghan
